ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/cls.zh: YOLO26 Classify 使用卷积主干与池化分类头，为整幅图像预测类别和置信度。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/cls.en: YOLO26 Classify uses a convolutional backbone and pooling classification head to predict image classes and confidence scores.

ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/seg.zh: YOLO26 Segment 结合直接边框回归与原型掩码，同时定位目标并生成实例分割结果。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/seg.en: YOLO26 Segment combines direct box regression and prototype masks to locate objects and generate instance segmentation results.

ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/pose.zh: YOLO26 Pose 在多尺度特征图上联合预测人体边框与 17 个关键点，输出人体姿态。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/pose.en: YOLO26 Pose jointly predicts human bounding boxes and 17 keypoints across multiple feature scales to estimate body poses.

ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/obb.zh: YOLO26 OBB 结合直接边框回归与角度预测，输出贴合目标朝向的旋转检测框。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/obb.en: YOLO26 OBB combines direct box regression and angle prediction to produce rotated boxes aligned with object orientations.
